\begin{lemma}
[Left and right unitors for $\otimes_X$]
  \label{lem:tensorobj_unit_iso}
  \lean{AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorObj_left_unitor, AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorObj_right_unitor}
  \uses{def:scheme_modules_tensorobj}
  Let \(X\) be a scheme and \(M \in \Scheme.\mathtt{Modules}\,X\) an
  \emph{arbitrary} \(\mathcal{O}_X\)-module. With
  \(\mathcal{O}_X = \mathtt{SheafOfModules.unit}\,X.\mathtt{ringCatSheaf}\) the
  structure-sheaf unit object, there are natural isomorphisms
  \[
    \mathcal{O}_X \otimes_X M \;\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\; M,
    \qquad
    M \otimes_X \mathcal{O}_X \;\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\; M .
  \]
\end{lemma}


=== unit_iso proof ===
\begin{proof}
  \uses{def:scheme_modules_tensorobj}
  The presheaf monoidal structure on \(\mathtt{PresheafOfModules}\,R\) supplies
  the left and right unitors \(\lambda, \rho\) at the presheaf level. Their
  sheafifications \(\mathtt{sheafification.mapIso}(\lambda)\),
  \(\mathtt{sheafification.mapIso}(\rho)\), composed with the sheafification
  counit identifying the sheafified structure-sheaf presheaf with
  \(\mathcal{O}_X\) (the step already used in the structure-sheaf-unit
  comparison \(\mathtt{tensorObj\_unit\_iso}\) in the substrate file), give the
  two isomorphisms. This route is the cheap \(\mathtt{mapIso}\) pattern and uses no
  abstract pullback.
\end{proof}

action \(\varepsilon_L\) from the chart-local left-unitor contractions. Its load-

data.content:
---
name: leandag
description: Consult and refresh the blueprint dependency DAG (leandag) — declaration dependencies, cones, proved status, isolated/dangling nodes, verified union/intersection across projects — via `horizon leandag` and the cached DAG files.
---

The DAG links blueprint nodes by `\uses` edges. An edge `source -> target` means
*target depends on source*. The engine records each node's `\lean` link,
`proved`/`leanok` status, effort metrics, and Lean source metadata.

## Keep It Fresh

- Run the project build after Lean/blueprint edits so generated Lean artifacts and
  imported libraries are current.
- Run `horizon blueprint` after blueprint or Lean declaration changes; it writes
  `.archon-horizon/blueprints/<project>.json` for the dashboard and cached DAG
  consumers.
- Use `horizon leandag` for live inspection when deciding what to prove next.

## `horizon leandag` (preferred)

- `horizon leandag` — per-project summary: nodes, edges, proved count, and any
  isolated nodes (no edge in or out — usually a blueprint bug to fix).
- `horizon leandag -p <project> --node <label>` — one node's direct deps, full
  transitive cone, and reverse deps.
- `horizon leandag -p a -p b --union` — merge projects by declaration/node id.
  Same-id nodes are combined; divergent non-signature metadata is tolerated, but
  a Lean signature mismatch is an error to investigate.
- `horizon leandag -p a -p b --intersect` — only shared declaration/node ids,
  with the same signature check.
- Add `--json` for machine-readable output.

A node is "ready" when all dependencies are proved. Prefer ready nodes when
choosing what to attempt next.

## Cached JSON

`horizon blueprint` writes each project's DAG to
`.archon-horizon/blueprints/<project>.json` (`nodes`, `edges`, `dangling`) for
the dashboard. Under the leandag engine, `\uses` are resolved at build/cache
time, so `dangling` is empty there; the parser fallback still populates it. To
check for orphan/unresolved nodes, use `horizon leandag` rather than relying only
on `dangling`.

Everything checks out — the `scratch_bareBC.lean`/`scratch_probe.lean` files and the Cohomology edit belong to the live T2 session (its FBC work), so I leave them untouched. The session is complete.

## Summary

**T1 done: the Line-Bundle-Comparison-Iso substrate is merged into AJC, the merged cone builds green (EXIT=0), the keystone `exists_tensorObj_inverse` and both `PicSharp.addCommGroup` instances are axiom-clean, blueprint + DAG updated, `AJC.linebundle` closed.** One caveat: a *full* AJC build couldn't be finished in-session because a concurrent run-0003 T2 session is actively rebuilding the Cohomology cone (issue `I-0016` filed).

## Progress

- Verified LBC = decl-superset of AJC pre-merge (keystone moved to `TensorObjInverse.lean`); the 7 AJC-only `DualInverse` decls and all moved decls had zero external consumers.
- Wholesale-lifted 5 diverged files (`TensorObjSubstrate.lean` 2185→4592 LOC, `DualInverse.lean`, `RelPicFunctor.lean` 747→1024, `Vestigial`/`LineBundlePullback` doc-only) and added 7 new files (incl. `TensorObjInverse.lean`, 3424 LOC).
- Retired `PullbackTensorComp.lean`: 13 decls duplicated verbatim in the new `TensorObjSubstrate.lean` (fatal root-import clash), 8 unique helpers unused; root imports rewired.
- Targeted `lake build` of the 13 merged modules + downstream (`SheafOverEquivalence`, `LineBundleCoherence`): **EXIT=0**, lint warnings only; Picard line-bundle cone now has 0 real sorries.
- `#print axioms`: `exists_tensorObj_inverse`, `PicSharp.addCommGroup`, `addCommGroup_via_tensorObj` → `propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound` only.
- Blueprint: ported LBC's `Picard_TensorObjSubstrate.tex` wholesale (comment-stripped cross-ref check: 0 dangling / 0 broken); added the 3 proof-`\leanok` marks; fixed the stale "principal open obligation" sentence; DAG refreshed — 2008 nodes, 0 dangling, all 3 nodes `proved: True`.
- Housekeeping: roadmap `AJC.linebundle` → done with closing comment; `I-0011` commented + completed; TO_USER.md updated in both projects; merge-recipe memory `I-0015` filed.

## Issues

- **Full AJC `lake build` unverified end-to-end**: stalled at 8623/8634 behind the concurrent T2 session's builds; killed my copy. Remaining ~11 jobs are T2's Cohomology cone + root module — not touched by this merge. Filed `I-0016` asking Ground for one confirming full build after T2 lands.
- Kept AJC's `Picard_RelPicFunctor.tex`/`Picard_LineBundlePullback.tex` chapters (LBC's restructured versions would dangle 6 `\cref` sites in `Picard_FGAPicRepresentability.tex`); their reconciliation is optional follow-up, noted in `I-0016`.
- `scratch_bareBC.lean`/`scratch_probe.lean` at AJC root belong to the live T2 session — left alone.

## Next

- Ground: run the confirming full `lake build` of AJC once T2 finishes; then `AJC.linebundle` is fully sealed.
- Optional: reconcile the two remaining blueprint chapters; archive/retire the `Line-Bundle-Comparison-Iso` subproject.
